ethiopia country program enjoys excellent rapport with the national and local government authorities in ethiopia including the ministry of health ministry of women and social affairs the refugees and returnees service authority for civil society organizations and regional administration and local government structures the country program also works with government institutions research academic humanitarian action more specifically our sectoral interventions address social protection health and wellbeing nutrition voice advocacy livelihoods protection and inclusion in both humanitarian and development contexts in line with its organizational commitment to the charter for change a key element of the helpage international global strategy 2030 helpage international has been transitioning
